source.title: Topical gel-based biomaterials for the treatment of diabetic foot ulcers
source.source_type: narrative review of topical gel-based biomaterials for diabetic foot ulcers

schema_gaps: The LiteratureAtom model is designed for primary literature and has no dedicated narrative-review synthesis or secondary-reported-result atom kind. Review-level syntheses are represented with existing kinds and descriptive tags.

QuantitativeResult stores a single numeric estimate and cannot directly encode inequalities such as >95%, approximate ranges, or multiple distinct timepoints in one assertion. These were normalized conservatively as minimum values when structured, with the exact source wording retained in original_result_text or left as qualitative_result.
extraction_limitations: The paper is a narrative review and reports heterogeneous animal models and clinical studies rather than generating a single primary study dataset.
No systematic search strategy, study-selection flow, formal risk-of-bias assessment, or evidence-certainty framework is reported in the article body.
The review tables compress cited-study methods and outcomes. Study-level details should be checked against the cited primary publications before reuse as primary evidence.
All model-extracted atoms remain needs_review because no independent human reviewer step is represented.
No external current-practice verification was performed because @VERIFY was not activated.
